title: How to Survive a Superintelligence!
note: Animation, sound effects style, pace and script

hook.firstFrame: A boy running to his white car outside a suburban house under smoky dark sky.
hook.firstLine: If superintelligence turns on us, don't get in your car.

techniques: Numbered step-by-step format breaks complex survival advice into digestible action steps.
Rapid scene cuts combined with sound effects maintain high tension and urgency throughout.
Relatable everyday smart devices create immediate personal stakes for the viewer.
Ending on a part-two tease leaves viewers eager to seek out the next installment.
